sentences.text: But do the pragmatists represent a genuine change or simply a shift in tactics to achieve the same ultimate goals: establishing a state that applies their strict interpretation of Islamic Sharia law both at home and in its dealings with the outside world?
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Neither al-Qaeda nor IS has achieved its ultimate dream: taking over one or more countries and ruling them according to their strict interpretation of Islam.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Both have suffered major defeats, lost leaders and faced years of international pressure.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: IS, which once controlled vast areas of Iraq and Syria, lost its last territorial stronghold in 2019.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: But jihadism hasn't gone away.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Africa is now the main battleground for jihadism, with al-Qaeda's powerful branches, JNIM in the Sahel (Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger) and al-Shabab in Somalia, fighting long-running insurgencies.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: IS, its bitter rival, has active branches in Nigeria, the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Sahel, Mozambique and Somalia.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: One major source of inspiration, and envy, whether jihadists admit it or not, is Syria's new president, Ahmed al-Sharaa .
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: The former IS and then al-Qaeda commander was once wanted by the US but rose to power in Syria in December 2024 and was welcomed by Western leaders.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Once known by his militant nom de guerre Abu Mohammed al-Jolani, he led the jihadist group Nusra Front - initially linked to IS and then al-Qaeda - and later the group Hayat Tahrir al-Sham (HTS).
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: He gradually broke ties with both IS and al-Qaeda and distanced himself from their calls for global jihad.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Instead, he focused on Syria, building a local power base in the north-western Idlib province.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: What surprised everyone was his growing willingness to work with non-Islamist groups and engage with foreign powers.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: As HTS advanced on Damascus, its leadership sought to reassure the international community, reaching out even to Russia, a key ally of then-president Bashar al-Assad, to allay fears of an Islamist takeover.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: That pragmatism, combined with favourable geopolitical conditions - including a weaker Russia and Iran - helped him take power in Syria.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: But the sight of him being welcomed by world leaders, including US President Donald Trump, was even more remarkable.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Trump joked with Sharaa when he visited the White House During Sharaa's visit to the White House in November 2025, Trump sprayed him with his own branded cologne, jokingly asked how many wives he had and praised him as a "very strong leader".
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: For some jihadists, Sharaa's success has been inspiring.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Others, however, see his actions as a betrayal of everything they believe in.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: IS has declared jihad against Syria's new Islamist government, branding Sharaa and his officials "apostates", and has carried out attacks against government forces on that basis.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Other hardline clerics have taken a similar stance, but have stopped short of openly calling for jihad against Sharaa.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: The divide between hardline jihadists and their more pragmatic counterparts has fuelled a bitter online debate since 2025, with rival voices trading accusations of betrayal and even publishing competing books to defend their positions.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Sharaa, centre, in 2016, was once a jihadist leader wanted by the FBI For hardliners, going too far can mean abandoning their core beliefs.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: This might include holding back from imposing their strict version of Islamic law, accepting "man-made" laws or a constitution, taking part in elections, working with non-Islamist groups, or building ties with governments they consider "infidel".
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Another source of inspiration for jihadists was the Taliban's return to power in Afghanistan in 2021, as it showed that an Islamist movement could eventually take control of a country after years of fighting Western-backed forces.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: It engaged local groups, slowly secured power across the country, used international diplomacy, and bided its time before taking the capital, Kabul, in a lightning offensive.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Two groups are especially worth watching: al-Qaeda's branches in Mali and Somalia.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: In late April, al-Qaeda's Sahel branch, known as JNIM, showed considerable pragmatism by joining forces with nationalist Tuareg separatists - whom it had occasionally fought - to launch a major offensive that threatened Mali's military rulers.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: It even went as far as to call the Tuaregs "brothers".
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: But it's not just JNIM's growing military strength that's attracting attention.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: It's also how the group is presenting itself.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Its propaganda once prominently featured al-Qaeda's leaders, slogans and calls for global jihad.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Since late 2024, however, its videos have dropped the familiar al-Qaeda branding.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: And instead of talking about global Muslim causes, JNIM has increasingly focused on local problems, portraying itself as a defender of ordinary people against corrupt and abusive rulers.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: It has repeatedly accused Mali's military government and its Russian allies of killing civilians and making people's lives worse.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: In April, it appealed to "all sincere patriots" to help build a "new Mali", promising security, justice and prosperity alongside Islamic law.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: It has even suggested it could have "balanced relations" with Russia, despite the fact they're fighting Russian forces backing Mali's government.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Its wording echoed that of HTS to Russia as it advanced on Damascus.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: There are parallels with Sharaa's approach in Syria: build local alliances, reassure potential enemies and avoid giving outside powers a reason to intervene.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Africa security specialist Aman Bezreh sees similarities between the two groups, but says JNIM's shift may take time.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: "JNIM has indeed shown signs of pragmatism similar to HTS", she says.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: "However, its rebranding has progressed more slowly because the group is simultaneously focused on expanding into new territories and recruiting from diverse pools." The debate over which path to follow is also taking place within JNIM's leadership, according to Wassim Nasr, a France 24 journalist and jihadism expert.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: He says one camp favours the Taliban's approach of taking power through force with minimal concessions.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: The other, which he says currently has the upper hand, favours an approach closer to that of Syria's HTS - making compromises and building wider alliances to gain power more quickly.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Nasr believes JNIM may borrow from both models, but that a break with al-Qaeda is inevitable as a result of its political evolution.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Like JNIM, al-Shabab in Somalia appears willing to make deals with former enemies.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: According to Abdullahi Guji, BBC Monitoring's Somalia specialist, al-Shabab reached a truce in October with a powerful Somali tribe, the Ma'awisley, whose fighters had been at the forefront of the fight against the group.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: The tribe has since withdrawn its fighters from the front line, dealing a serious blow to the government's campaign against jihadists, says Guji.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Guji believes the group may soon have a chance to test whether it can seize power and establish itself as an alternative government across wider parts of the country.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: African Union forces are withdrawing from Somalia amid funding cuts and the approaching end of their mandate in December.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Meanwhile, the Somali government is facing political crises and rebellions, creating vulnerabilities al-Shabab could exploit, he adds.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: There's another reason some jihadists may see an opportunity to expand: they believe Western governments have bigger fish to fry.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: With the war in Ukraine, US-Iran conflict in the Middle East and growing rivalries with China and Russia, fighting jihadists is no longer the priority it was after 9/11.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: The US withdrawal from Afghanistan in 2021 and the Taliban's return to power, followed by Sharaa's rise in Syria, have reinforced that belief.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: The Taliban has inspired many jihadists Colin Clarke, executive director of the Soufan Center, a non-profit research group that focuses on security, says some jihadist groups have learnt that avoiding confrontation with the US can help them escape Western military action and "live to fight another day".
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: That doesn't mean the West has stopped fighting terrorism.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: But if jihadists believe it is distracted or less willing to intervene, they may feel emboldened to pursue power.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Unlike its fiercely uncompromising rival IS, al-Qaeda has long shown some flexibility in pursuing its goals.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: But history offers a warning.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: After the 2011 Arab uprisings, which largely sidelined al-Qaeda, affiliated jihadist groups in Yemen, Libya and Tunisia began using the name Ansar al-Sharia (Supporters of Sharia) to win local support without carrying the al-Qaeda brand.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: In Mali in 2012, al-Qaeda leaders advised jihadists who had seized the north alongside Tuareg separatists not to rush into imposing strict Islamic rules.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Instead, they urged them to work with local allies, avoid alienating communities and play down their al-Qaeda links.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: The message wasn't to give up their ambitions.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: It was to show strategic patience until the time was right.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: That same thinking could be at work today.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Democrats have an identity crisis - it won't be an easy fix Russia's mega-rich are already imagining a future after Putin Europe's youth is on the march - but does anything actually unite them?
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: So are these groups really changing their ambitions, or just their tactics?
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Even those advocating compromise aren't necessarily abandoning their dream of establishing a state ruled by their strict interpretation of Islamic law.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Clarke wonders whether this more pragmatic approach could be a "Trojan horse strategy" – a way for jihadist groups to gain power without giving up their longer-term goals.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: "The big question is whether being in power actually moderates these groups, or whether they're simply changing their tactics to survive and strengthen their position," he says.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: But not everyone is changing tactics.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: IS remains firmly committed to its global ambitions and rejects compromise.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Al-Qaeda's Yemen branch, AQAP, continues to call for attacks against the US and Israel, and urges "lone wolf" attacks against Western and Jewish targets.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: And it's too early to say whether groups like JNIM and al-Shabab will follow the Taliban or Syrian examples, and whether they're willing to make compromises.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Some jihadist groups may become more focused on local politics as they face the challenges of governing.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: Others may simply be hiding their wider ambitions until they're strong enough to pursue them.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: The global jihadist dream may have failed, but jihadism is far from finished.
sentences.article_title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?

sentences.text: It is rare for such a high-ranking official to face public criminal trials in Kenya A former Kenyan governor has been jailed for 25 years for the murder of a university student who was seven months pregnant with his child.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: The High Court on Friday sentenced Zacharia Okoth Obado, the former governor of Migori County, along with two former aides, over the 2018 killing of Sharon Belyne Otieno.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: The investigation established that an "intimate relationship" had existed between Obado and Otieno, which "subsequently led to a pregnancy with the deceased that the governor was unhappy about".
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: Both Obado and Otieno's legal teams said they would appeal against the sentence.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: His former personal assistant, Michael Oyamo, was also sentenced to 25 years in prison, while former county clerk Caspal Ojwang' Obiero received an 18-year sentence.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: The court found that Obado had provided the motive and financial resources for the murder, while Oyamo coordinated its execution and Obiero provided logistical support and helped conceal the crime.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: Judge Cecilia Githua said Obado's absence from Migori at the time of the killing did not absolve him of responsibility.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: She rejected the prosecution's request for the death penalty, as well as Obado's plea for a non-custodial sentence.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: Otieno, 26, was killed between 3 and 4 September 2018 after leaving a hotel in Rongo, south-western Kenya, with journalist Barrack Oduor.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: She had contacted Oduor to discuss her relationship with the then-governor.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: The two were abducted shortly afterwards.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: Oduor managed to escape by jumping out of a moving vehicle.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: His account of the abduction became a crucial lead in the investigation.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: Otieno's body was later found near Kodera Forest.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: A post-mortem examination found that she had died from strangulation and excessive bleeding caused by multiple stab wounds.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: The court also established that Obado was the biological father of her unborn child.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: Obado and his co-accused were convicted of murder on 23 July 2026, following a lengthy trial in which prosecutors called 42 witnesses and presented 81 exhibits.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: On Friday, the court declined to award compensation to Otieno's family, saying there was insufficient evidence to establish the financial losses they had claimed.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: Before sentencing, Otieno's mother had appealed to the judge not to send Obado to prison, saying his imprisonment would amount to "another death in the family".
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: She urged the court to consider a non-custodial sentence, arguing that Otieno's three children, from different relationships, needed his support.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: But the judge said the family's circumstances could not override the court's responsibility to impose an appropriate punishment.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: Otieno's family, through their lawyer Antony Opondo, told Kenya's Daily Nation that they would file an appeal seeking Obado's acquittal.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: Otieno's murder sparked protests and renewed public debate about violence against women in Kenya.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: A national survey found that at least 34% of women had experienced physical violence in 2022.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: The case has also drawn attention because it is rare for such senior political figures to face public criminal trials in Kenya.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: Obado served two terms as governor of Migori County in western Kenya, switching allegiance between a smaller political party and the region's dominant opposition movement.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: He later backed President William Ruto and formally joined his ruling party in 2023, becoming a regional organiser.
sentences.article_title: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder

sentences.text: Transitional President Gen Horta N'Tam said the postponement was driven by factors including final reasons Guinea-Bissau's military rulers have postponed elections scheduled for next week by two years, delaying the return to civilian rule.
sentences.article_title: Guinea-Bissau's military leaders delay return to civilian rule until 2028

sentences.text: Transitional President Gen Horta N'Tam announced in a decree that the presidential and parliamentary elections, originally due on 6 December, would now take place on 26 November 2028.
sentences.article_title: Guinea-Bissau's military leaders delay return to civilian rule until 2028

sentences.text: The announcement came exactly a year after the military seized power, promising to return the country to civilian rule within 12 months.
sentences.article_title: Guinea-Bissau's military leaders delay return to civilian rule until 2028

sentences.text: In a statement, the presidency said an assessment of electoral preparations had found that there were insufficient "technical, material and financial conditions" to hold the polls as planned.
sentences.article_title: Guinea-Bissau's military leaders delay return to civilian rule until 2028

sentences.text: It said the delay would provide more time to ensure the elections were credible, transparent and inclusive, with all candidates given equal opportunities.
sentences.article_title: Guinea-Bissau's military leaders delay return to civilian rule until 2028

sentences.text: The presidency also reiterated its commitment to holding the country's first-ever local government elections but gave no date for the vote.
sentences.article_title: Guinea-Bissau's military leaders delay return to civilian rule until 2028

sentences.text: Gen N'Tam was sworn in as transitional president a day after the military overthrew President Umaro Sissoco Embaló in November 2025.
sentences.article_title: Guinea-Bissau's military leaders delay return to civilian rule until 2028

sentences.text: The coup took place three days after general elections and a day before provisional results were due to be announced.
sentences.article_title: Guinea-Bissau's military leaders delay return to civilian rule until 2028

sentences.text: Both Embaló and his main challenger, Fernando Dias, had claimed victory.
sentences.article_title: Guinea-Bissau's military leaders delay return to civilian rule until 2028

sentences.text: Embaló, who has since been living in exile in Morocco, was barred from returning to Guinea-Bissau last month, despite expressing an interest in contesting the elections.
sentences.article_title: Guinea-Bissau's military leaders delay return to civilian rule until 2028

sentences.text: The planned withdrawal will end Uganda's nearly two-year campaign against ADF militants in Lubero Uganda has announced plans to withdraw its troops from a town in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo within two weeks, as diplomatic tensions escalate between the two neighbours.
sentences.article_title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row

sentences.text: The troops will hand over security in Lubero, in North Kivu province, to Congolese forces after nearly two years of military operations, the Ugandan army said in a statement on Friday.
sentences.article_title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row

sentences.text: The announcement comes days after DR Congo summoned Uganda's top diplomat in Kinshasa over controversial social media posts by Uganda's military chief, Gen Muhoozi Kainerugaba, who is the son of President Yoweri Museveni.
sentences.article_title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row

sentences.text: The Ugandan military did not give a reason for the withdrawal or say whether it was linked to the diplomatic row.
sentences.article_title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row

sentences.text: What are Ugandan forces doing in DR Congo?
sentences.article_title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row

sentences.text: The Uganda People's Defence Forces (UPDF) were deployed to Lubero to pursue fighters from the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) Islamist group fleeing joint military operations elsewhere in eastern DR Congo.
sentences.article_title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row

sentences.text: The ADF, which originated in Uganda in the 1990s, is affiliated to the Islamic State and has been blamed for numerous deadly attacks on civilians in both countries.
sentences.article_title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row

sentences.text: Uganda first deployed troops to eastern DR Congo under the current joint military campaign in November 2021, following a series of bomb attacks in the Ugandan capital, Kampala.
sentences.article_title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row

sentences.text: Ugandan army spokesperson Col Chris Magezi said that the joint military campaign, known as Operation Shujaa, would continue elsewhere in DR Congo.
sentences.article_title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row

sentences.text: The planned withdrawal applies only to Lubero town.
sentences.article_title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row

sentences.text: Five years into the joint offensive, the ADF remains DR Congo's deadliest armed group, despite a significant decline in its activities in Uganda, according to the conflict monitoring organisation Armed Conflict Location & Event Data (Acled).
sentences.article_title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row

sentences.text: John Ngono, Acled's DR Congo analyst, said the group was killing an average of four civilians a day and had expanded into previously unaffected parts of eastern DR Congo.
sentences.article_title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row

sentences.text: He said the findings suggested that "Operation Shujaa may have improved security in Uganda while shifting the geographical impact of violence within the DRC".
sentences.article_title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row

sentences.text: Acled says the group has not carried out an attack in Uganda since June 2025, but its growing interest in mineral resources in DR Congo could help finance its operations and sustain its ability to threaten both countries.
sentences.article_title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row

sentences.text: The planned withdrawal comes amid strained relations between Uganda and DR Congo, despite years of close military co-operation.
sentences.article_title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row

sentences.text: Earlier this week, Gen Kainerugaba appeared to endorse a rebel takeover of Walikale, a mineral-rich territory in eastern DR Congo, threatening that Ugandan troops would seize it themselves if the rebels failed to do so.
sentences.article_title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row

sentences.text: The Congolese foreign ministry described his remarks as "particularly serious" and demanded that Uganda clarify its official position and take steps to prevent similar incidents.
sentences.article_title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row

sentences.text: Gen Kainerugaba also defended Uganda's military presence in eastern DR Congo, insisting it was driven by security concerns.
